chunks.text:
[First Step]
{the climbing bass figure sets off at once with the march snare, one brass stab, and the lead's bold rising call arrives in the second bar}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
plucked sampled bass climbing stepwise up the scale, a step higher every bar
warm sampled brass stabs on the downbeats
a high bell glint at the top of each phrase
sampled 16-bit march snare on two and four with tom fills
climbing a lighthouse tower stair, steady resolve with a thread of tension
